idea-plugin.name: Maven Central Publish Gate
idea-plugin.description:
Read a pom.xml the way the Central Portal reads it, before you burn a release tag

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → Maven Central Publish Gate: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 16 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/maven-central-publish-gate (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/maven-central-publish-gate

action.text: Maven Central Publish Gate: Check This File
action.description: Run Maven Central Publish Gate on the file in the editor
